text:
Maria: FYI I hit a 404 from the runtime guide TOC -> the 'kernel selection' link returns 404. Repro: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime#kernel-selection
Sam: thanks for the report — can you paste the exact broken href so I can patch directly?
Maria: the link target is `/runtime/compilation/kernels.md` (shortlink), clicking from the TOC goes to a 404. Looks like a redirect regressed.
DocsBot: crawl-scan detected 1 broken internal link in /runtime/compilation (ticket DOCS-4321) :warning:
Liam: I'm owning runtime docs this sprint — I'll take this one if someone can open the tiny fix PR.
Anya: I can open the PR in ~15m. Will replace shortlink with canonical `/docs/runtime/compilation/kernels` and add a redirect entry.
Kevin: heads-up: that kernels page is referenced from the ja runtime guide too. @Anya can you add a note to the PR for i18n so we don't orphan the localized anchor?
Anya: yep will add a comment and cc i18n team, maybe add a follow-up ticket for translation drift.
Sam: quick checklist for PR: 1) update link in the TOC 2) add redirect in redirects.yaml 3) put a short changelog entry.
Maria: also tiny extra: the image on the kernels page missing alt text, can you add `alt="kernel selection diagram"` while you're editing?
Anya: noted — will patch alt text and run markdownlint locally before pushing.
Liam: can you assign me as reviewer @Anya? I can do a quick pass and merge after CI.
Anya: assigning now, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10234 (small edits + redirect)
Sam: thanks. @DocsBot any chance to rerun the link scan after merge?
DocsBot: link-scan scheduled on merge; will run nightly and post results to #docs.
Kevin: i18n FYI — the PR references the ja guide; if we need a localized redirect we should create a tiny follow-up ticket.
Maria: perfect, thanks everyone. If the PR lands before end of day we can close DOCS-4321. :thumbsup:
Liam: I'll ping again if anything blocks review.
Anya: PR opened and tests passing locally, pushing now.
DocsBot: deploy-preview built: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/10234 — quick smoke looks good.
Sam: lgtm, merging when CI green.
Maria: cheers — appreciate the quick turnaround! :coffee:
